entities.summary: The differentiation of the Latgalian, Selonian, Semigallian, and Curonian tribes. Hillforts, amber trade, and contacts with the Roman world along the 'Amber Road'. The distinctive Baltic tribal cultures and their relationship with neighbouring Slavic, Finnic, and Scandinavian peoples.
